candidate.text: First, calculate the levy on the first 3000 credits: 3000 credits * 22% = 660 credits.  Next, calculate the remaining credits: 9207 - 3000 = 6207 credits.  Then, calculate the levy on the remaining 6207 credits: 6207 credits * 38% = 2357.06 credits.  Now, calculate the total levy before the rebate: 660 + 2357.06 = 3017.06 credits.  Subtract the 6-credit rebate: 3017.06 - 6 = 3011.06 credits.  Finally, apply the 7% surcharge: 3011.06 * 7% = 210.7942 credits.  Add the surcharge to the reduced levy: 3011.06 + 210.7942 = 3221.8542 credits.  The exact final levy is 3221.8542 credits.
